newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Mercury Energy posts NZ$53.9 mln 6 mth profit.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Mercury Energy posts NZ$53.9 mln 6 mth profit.

text.p: Unlisted New Zealand eletricity supplier Mercury Energy on Wednesday reported an unaudited net profit after tax of NZ$53.9 million for the six months to September 30, 1996, up from the $36.2 million posted for the same period in 1995.
Mercury said it expected to post a full year profit of $81.6 million, an increase of 24 percent on last year.
The interim result included a final dividend declared by Power New Zealand, in which Mercury has a 32 percent stake, of $12 million.
Mercury declared an interim dividend of $25 million to be paid in March 1997 to the Auckland Energy Consumer Trust.
Mercury said it was reinvesting the balance of its earnings in major generation and power supply reinforcement projects aimed at ensuring security of supply for its customers.

Mercury said it was continuing to acquire shares in neighbouring Power New Zealand as it was more convinced than ever that a merger of the two operations would produce significant benefits for Auckland consumers.
Mercury is waging a long-running battle for Power NZ shares with Utilicorp New Zealand, which is 79 percent owned by Utilicorp United Inc.
